## Roadmap review
Change record, affected IDs, unchanged-stage rationale where applicable, source fingerprint and generation/check results.

## Provenance
Actual provider/model or unknown, UTC, base SHA. Preserve original and third-party attribution.

No private auth/profile/log material, unverified hosted CI claim or bypass of denied publication.

## Orchestrator coordination (if agent-assisted)
- [ ] Issue assigned/claimed with no competing worker; dependency PRs checked
- [ ] Worker branch/worktree and target base SHA recorded; overlapping files reviewed
- [ ] Regression RED before GREEN, scoped tests and cross-platform limits documented
- [ ] Run node scripts/orchestration/verify.mjs --quick on submitted head
- [ ] Hosted check name/run/commit verified; CI fail/unknown is not accepted PASS
- [ ] Sensitive source changed? Human review required; no premature auto-merge
